设计意图： This factor targets a market-phase transition mechanism: long-term uptrends become more valuable when the slow trend is accelerating and price is breaking above the slow average. It is not a generic momentum stack; the signal emphasizes expansion out of a neutral phase into a sustained cycle upswing, which is characteristic of the Market Structure & Cycle layer.

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ 已翻转（IC<0）⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

-((close - SMA60)/SMA60 + 0.5*(SMA60 - SMA60[20]) / ts_mean(range20) + 0.25*(SMA20 - SMA60)/SMA60)
依赖列: open, high, low, close, volume

AdjLow后复权最低复权后的当日最低价

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 close：close
  2. 计算 high：high
  3. 计算 low：low
  4. 计算 slow_ma：close.滚动窗口(60, min_periods=60).mean()
  5. 计算 fast_ma：close.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).mean()
  6. 计算 trend_slope：slow_ma - slow_ma.shift(20)
  7. 计算 range_：(high - low).滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).mean()
  8. 计算 range_：range_
  9. 计算 breakout：(close - slow_ma) / slow_ma
  10. 计算 acceleration：trend_slope / range_
  11. 计算 factor：breakout + 0.5 * acceleration + 0.25 * ((fast_ma - slow_ma) / slow_ma)
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_phase_acceleration_breakout(df): """Long-horizon trend phase transition: detect when price breaks above its slow trend ">class="kw">while the slow trend itself is accelerating, capturing market expansion ">class="kw">from consolidation into a sustained cycle upswing.""" df_copy = df.copy() close = df_copy["close"] high = df_copy["high"] low = df_copy["low"] slow_ma = close.rolling(60, min_periods=60).mean() fast_ma = close.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean() trend_slope = slow_ma - slow_ma.shift(20) range_ = (high - low).rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean() range_ = range_.replace(0.0, np.nan) breakout = (close - slow_ma) / slow_ma.replace(0.0, np.nan) acceleration = trend_slope / range_ factor = breakout + 0.5 * acceleration + 0.25 * ((fast_ma - slow_ma) / slow_ma.replace(0.0, np.nan)) df_copy["factor_phase_acceleration_breakout"] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_phase_acceleration_breakout"]
